decision: read the whole UI surface and the project's own rules before changing anything
why: a redesign this size needs to know what it will break
result: 30 routes, 45 feature components, 220 markup-dependent test queries found

decision: built a screenshot harness and captured the old UI first
why: so the change is judged against a baseline instead of memory
result: 16 baseline screenshots, desktop and mobile, dark and light

decision: kept the ember accent and raised the two quiet greys
why: the source palette's dim grey measured 3.15:1, under the 4.5:1 body-text floor
result: all 58 pairs clear their thresholds

decision: gave light mode a neutral ground and its own darker accent
why: the dark accent measures 3.32:1 on white, so it cannot be reused there
result: light ember #a05526 measures 5.36:1 on the light ground

decision: split hairlines from control boundaries in the audit
why: a decorative divider carries no meaning, an input boundary must be perceivable
result: field border 3.72:1 dark and 3.30:1 light, dividers unchecked

decision: noted this model cannot view images, so visual checks route to computed styles and to the user
why: a screenshot I cannot see proves nothing
result: verification plan changed to measured style audits plus screenshots for a human

decision: wrote a design-rule linter for the palette and the retired patterns
why: so the brief's hard rules are checked rather than remembered
result: running it on the current globals.css flags all 20 acid-yellow values

decision: fixed the linter's arrow rule after it flagged ordinary markup
why: the rule matched a bare angle bracket before a closing anchor tag
result: the rule now needs an anchor and an arrow glyph on the same line

decision: sent three design directions to build in parallel as real HTML
why: judging built pages beats arguing about adjectives
result: three files, one per direction, built independently

decision: initialised shadcn with the radix base and no component reinstall
why: needed a maintained primitive layer, and radix matches the packages already installed
result: config written, nothing of mine overwritten except lib/utils.ts

decision: restored lib/utils.ts after the CLI replaced it with a one-line re-export
why: the CLI silently deleted eleven helpers that twenty files import
evidence: git show HEAD:lib/utils.ts, verified identical to HEAD
result: typecheck green again, removed the bogus cn dependency the CLI added

decision: replaced the token layer with Ember, one source, both themes
why: tokens lived in three places and the light theme was unreachable
result: globals.css lints clean, typecheck green, all routes serve

decision: measured the live landing page after the token swap
why: the token layer is only worth anything if the browser agrees with the file
result: off-palette colours: none, focus ring 2px ember offset 2px, two contrast bugs found

decision: found muted text on the accent fill measuring 1.3:1 on the landing workflow card
why: the old palette had the same bug, so it is a real defect rather than a migration slip
result: open, fixed when the landing page is rebuilt

decision: taught the page audit to ignore fully transparent shadow placeholders
why: Tailwind emits them as ring placeholders and they were drowning the real signal
result: re-run reports only shadows that render

decision: chose Field Manual typography with the Proof Sheet evidence spine as the design language
why: Field Manual had the strongest type system and Proof Sheet the most product-specific idea, and both converged on the same margin column
result: decided, recorded in docs/specs/2026-09-25-ember-redesign.md

decision: set the build order so the landing page and app chrome finish first
why: the user picked visibility as the priority if the run stops early
result: open, drives steps 3 and 4

decision: kept serif prose for the document and sans for chrome
why: the reading surface is the differentiator and almost no competitor sets specs as a document
result: open, implemented in the reading surface

decision: rebuilt the header and footer on the new tokens, solid ground and a background-step active state
why: frosted chrome needs a contrast fallback and a solid header is simpler and guaranteed
result: page audit reports a 60px fixed header, content clear, focus ring correct

decision: rebuilt the landing page around a rendered specification instead of a marquee and a stack banner
why: the hero should show the product rather than describe it in adjectives
result: off-palette colours none, contrast failures none, prose 68 characters, no shadows

decision: moved the Clerk appearance onto token variables so both themes follow from one declaration
why: the appearance previously hardcoded the palette a third time and forced uppercase on Clerk's own labels
result: sign-in audit shows zero off-palette colours, which proves Clerk resolves the variables

decision: made the artifact render as a document with anchors, a table of contents, and claim state in the margin
why: the review experience is the gap in the market and the reason for the redesign
result: typed 17px serif prose, 3 font roles, no contrast failures

decision: found tables were missing from the markdown sanitize allowlist so spec tables rendered as nothing
why: specifications are full of field tables and they were being silently dropped
result: tables now render, 11 tests pass

decision: wrote the claim manifest parser and learned the no-evidence form has no colon
why: the test caught it: the format is Evidence not captured, not Evidence: not captured
result: 13 tests pass

decision: added a development-only preview route so the reading surface is screenshotable without signing in
why: authenticated surfaces cannot be captured without credentials, so the differentiator was otherwise unverifiable
result: 20 screenshots captured across both themes and two viewports

decision: found that cn() was silently deleting every Ember type-scale utility
why: tailwind-merge cannot infer text-caption from a value pattern and treated it as a text colour, so size and colour cancelled each other
evidence: lib/utils.ts, verified with a direct cn() call
result: fixed with extendTailwindMerge; text-label text-dim now keeps both

decision: rethemed 18 primitives without changing a single export, prop or variant name
why: 44 files import Button and 26 import Card, so an API change would have rippled everywhere
result: gates green

decision: gave modals a dedicated scrim token, dark in both themes
why: the previous value was a near-white wash in light mode, which left a modal floating on white
result: bg-scrim resolves to 40% dark in light and 75% in dark

decision: swept the new registry primitives onto the type and radius scale
why: they arrived with text-sm, text-xs, rounded-md and rounded-xl from the registry defaults
result: no off-scale size or radius class remains in components/ui

decision: replaced four emoji section icons with lucide icons
why: the token lint caught them, and emoji as icons is a tell the brief bans
result: lint clean

decision: ran the full gate set
why: the redesign only counts if the repo's own gates agree
evidence: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, node design/audit-contrast.mjs, node .keel/validate-docs-lifecycle.mjs
result: 580 tests pass, contrast passes, docs lifecycle passes

decision: measured the three public surfaces in the browser
why: a token file agreeing with itself proves nothing about what renders
result: no off-palette colour, no contrast failure, no shadow, 3 font roles, correct focus ring on all three

decision: rewired seven primitives that imported cn from the npm package instead of lib/utils
why: the shadcn add command re-added the cn dependency and its own cn lacks the type-scale fix, so the bug was still live for those files
result: imports rewritten, cn and react-fast-marquee and cmdk uninstalled

decision: rebuilt the four error and not-found pages
why: they still carried the acid-yellow gradient grid, corner brackets, a blur glow and uppercase headings, which the spec listed for deletion but nothing had checked
result: no acid-yellow literal and no brutalist decoration remains under app/

decision: taught the linter to see off-scale type, radius and tracking utilities
why: the earlier claim that a sweep left no off-scale class was unprovable because the linter had no such rule
result: real count over app, components, hooks and lib: 835 errors and 205 uppercase warnings, all in surfaces steps 6, 7 and 9 still own

decision: added a token sync audit so the stylesheet cannot drift from the token file
why: the docs claimed the theme block was generated but the values are mirrored by hand
result: 38 values compared across both themes, 0 mismatches

decision: wired the design gates into CI
why: the ADR claimed a build-failing contrast audit and nothing was running in CI
result: contrast, token sync and the palette lint run over the migrated surfaces; the file list grows per surface

decision: added a theme switch to the footer
why: light mode rendered in the harness but no user could reach it, which was the original complaint about the old build
result: toggle reads and writes the next-themes class

decision: re-measured sign-in after a challenge that it carried Clerk default shadows and two off-scale radii
why: the reviewer measured Clerk's loading skeleton; steady state differs
result: steady state: radii 6px only, shadows none, no off-palette, no contrast failure

decision: ran the e2e suite, which no earlier step had run
why: the last untested gate
result: 4 passed

decision: ran a rule table over 54 files instead of editing each by hand
why: 835 errors were mechanical: 610 off-scale type, 200 tracking, 15 radius, 10 emoji
evidence: design/lint-tokens.mjs, rule table in the session log
result: 2100 replacements, whole-tree lint 835 to 0 errors and 205 to 0 warnings

decision: caught and repaired a truncated token the rule table produced
why: the shade alternation matched 50 inside 500, so bg-emerald-500 became bg-sage0
evidence: git grep over HEAD, 278 occurrences, 28 files
result: all 278 repaired; SHADE now alternates longest-first

decision: found the dead text-v-h2 and text-v-h3 scale still referenced by 41 call sites in 26 files
why: step 1 deleted the tokens and nothing replaced the call sites, so those headings rendered at the inherited size
evidence: components/ui/card.tsx was already correct, so the drift was page-level only
result: grep count 41 to 0, replaced with text-heading and text-title

decision: found page-header referenced by ten heroes and never defined
why: browser inspection showed the hero band had no padding, because the utility was deleted with the token layer and not restored
evidence: app/globals.css had page-container and page-section only
result: one shared header treatment defined and the ten heroes rebuilt on it

decision: collapsed the workflow to one stepper and one next action per page
why: the project page and the phase page each described the same eight phases three or four times
result: components/add-section-menu.tsx carries the only re-enable control; 30 workflow tests pass

decision: made the reading surface mermaid-aware and split-safe
why: an artifact with a diagram fence lost the diagram and would have shifted every later anchor
result: renderSpecHtml takes startIndex, countSpecHeadings reports the cursor, 10 tests cover it

decision: replaced the card-and-modal artifact view with the document
why: the spec is the product and the view treated it as a card with a collapsed preview
result: header carries identity and actions, body is the document, critique sits behind a disclosure

decision: rewrote the two legal pages off a client motion wrapper onto the document language
why: they carried a faded display heading, 4px accent rules and a font-weight 500 body, the loudest retired pattern left in the tree
result: audit-page reports 2 font families, 7 sizes, no off-palette colour, no contrast failure

decision: ran the full gate set
why: typecheck, lint, tests, build, e2e, contrast, token sync, whole-tree lint, live-page audit
evidence: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build, npm run test:e2e, the four design scripts
result: 591 unit tests pass, 4 e2e pass, build exit 0, lint 0 errors tree-wide, no contrast failure on 7 routes

decision: pointered the CI lint at the whole tree rather than a growing file list
why: every surface is migrated, so a hand-maintained list only creates a way to miss a new file
result: the job lints 277 files, exit 0

decision: deleted the redesign plan and promoted its durable content into ADR 0001
why: the lifecycle requires a completed plan to be deleted, and the supersession of the phase-2 page composition is a settled decision
result: validator passes, phase 3 marked complete, the plan link removed
